QuestInfo.name: Crackshot Bow
QuestInfo.0: If you complete a #b#emission#n#k during the event period, you will be given this #r#eDREAM ITEM#k#n that all Bowmen covet... what could it possibly be? Go talk to #bMaple Administrator#k.
QuestInfo.1:
If you fill up #b#e#t4220187##n#k with Bowman's energy, you will obtain the #r#eDREAM ITEM#k, #t1452169# or #t1462158##n, that all Bowmen covet. 

#eTip.#n Bowman Marble can be charged by hunting #bmonsters within your level range#k.
#b* Monsters within level range: Monsters whose level is not more than 10 levels lower, and not more than 20 levels higher)
QuestInfo.2: The Maple Administrator told you that if you fill up #b#e#t4220187##n#k with Bowman's energy during the event period, you will be given the #r#eDREAM ITEM#k, #t1452169# or #t1462158##n, that all Magicians covet. Of course, you listened to her suggestion, completed the mission, and obtained Bowman's #rDREAM ITEM#k.

0.0: I'll stop polishing my award-nominated collection of staplers long enough to give you your next task. You'll get to pick between two arrow-shooters for completing it. What do you say?\r\n#i1452169:# #t1452169#\n#i1462158:# #t1462158#

yes.0: You've made the right choice! Fill up this #b#t4220187##k with Bowman's energy to get your prize. Here's how...
yes.1: Simply #e#beliminate monsters#k#n and the #t4220187# will slowly fill up. Remember, #ronly monsters that less than 11 levels below you and 21 levels higher than you will count.#k The instant you're done, I will appear, because I keep tabs on every single Mapler in Maple World, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

no.0: You're making a mistake. A BIG mistake. In fact, I feel sorry for you.

1.0: Ah, I was just organizing my paperclips into perfect stacks of ten. Please, don't breath too hard or you'll knock them over. Now, which sword would you like?

yes.0: I hope you enjoy that. I know it was a big help when I was using it to scrape lint from between my filing cabinets.
